interface.shortDescription: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck a
interface.longDescription: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.
